INSERT INTO llm_usage (workflow, call_node, model, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, total_tokens, cost_usd, ref)
SELECT $1, $2, $3, $4, $5, COALESCE($4, 0) + COALESCE($5, 0),
       ROUND((COALESCE($4, 0) / 1000000.0) * COALESCE(p.in_per_1m, 0)
           + (COALESCE($5, 0) / 1000000.0) * COALESCE(p.out_per_1m, 0), 6),
       $6
FROM (SELECT 1 AS one) s
LEFT JOIN llm_pricing p ON p.model = $3
RETURNING id, cost_usd;
